lines.zh: 我六条腿交错着爬过碎石。
lines.en: Six legs cross the gravel in alternation.
My sickle forelimbs stay folded at my chest.

lines.zh: 甲壳一节一节地拱起来。
lines.en: My shell arches segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我用桨状的足划着空气。
lines.en: My paddle feet row at the air.
I keep low to the ground.
Dead leaves rustle under my body.
My antennae probe ahead.
I avoid a gap in the stone.
My joints click once, then again.
Slow, but I never go off course.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把镰刀转了转。
lines.en: I stop and swivel my sickles.
I slip between the roots.

lines.zh: 六只脚一起动，声音很细。
lines.en: Six feet move together, barely a sound.
I follow the damp base of the wall.
I raise my front half and look.
I shift forward another stretch.
I crouch, sickles held tight.
My antennae circle in the air.
My shell darkens in the shade.
The draft in the crack carries a scent.

lines.zh: 六条腿细得几乎看不见。
lines.en: Six legs so thin they nearly vanish.

lines.zh: 我把镰刀收进胸前的缝。
lines.en: I tuck my sickles into the gap under my chest.

lines.zh: 一只虫从旁边爬过，我不动。
lines.en: A bug crawls by. I don't move.
I wait for it to pass.
My sickles open and close once.
The damp is heavy here.

lines.zh: 触角指向碎石响的地方。
lines.en: My antennae point at the rattle of gravel.
I'm small. Not worth noticing.
I raise my head, antennae up.
Your boot has sealed the mouth of the crack.
I study your feet.

lines.zh: 你的影子压住了整条缝。
lines.en: Your shadow fills the whole crack.
I keep still and watch.
My sickles rest against my chest.
You crouch and I back away.
Your shadow buries me.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的鞋尖溜过去。
lines.en: I slip past, grazing the tip of your shoe.
A boot sole stops right above my head.
A crack opens in my shell.
Six legs kick out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 甲壳朝下，我六条腿空蹬。
lines.en: Shell down, my six legs claw at nothing.
Pain keeps my sickles from closing.
I squeeze into the crack.
My fluid is leaking.
My antennae are bent, so I shake them out.
That was too heavy.
I need to hide.

lines.zh: 腿还听使唤，我往缝里退。
lines.en: My legs still answer, so I back into the crack.
There's the smell of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 你丢下来的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what you dropped.

lines.zh: 我沿着石缝往那味道爬。
lines.en: I crawl along the stone seam toward that smell.
I touch it with my antennae first.
Is this edible?
I clamp it and look it over.
It would only half fill my mouth.
I drag it under a stone.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把叶子吹动了。
lines.en: Your breath stirs the leaves.
I eat slowly.
A kick flips me onto my shell.
Six legs kick wildly.
I struggle back upright.
My shell clicks under the pressure.
I hurry into a crevice.
The tremor runs along the stone crack.
My sickle got bent.
I am swept into the corner and curl up.
I'm only passing through.
Don't tread on me.

lines.zh: 同类在石下，触角先碰到。
lines.en: A kin under the stone; our antennae meet first.

lines.zh: 我们绕了一圈，互相试探。
lines.en: We circle once, testing each other.
Its sickles are shorter than mine.
I press my belly close and probe.
Then we separate.
Eggs will be left in the crevice.
I cover them with dead leaves.
It's damp enough here.
I crawl back to my own spot.
Nothing will change.
I clamp it with my sickles.
There are fine teeth on the inner edge.
My sickle brings it up to my mouthparts.
It's still moving.

lines.zh: 腐肉软得一下就陷进去。
lines.en: The rotten flesh gives way at the first bite.
The shell is too hard.
I drag it into the crack.
I dropped it; I'll clamp again.
Nobody gets this mouthful but me.
I hide it under the leaves.
Something is nearby.
All my antennae stand up.

lines.zh: 血腥味从你裤脚飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts off your trouser leg.
I open my sickles.
Six legs tense.
It stands, and I barely reach its ankle.
I don't plan a frontal approach.
I slip around behind its heel.
The crevice is my road.
Hide first, then look.
I fix on its legs.
Wait for it to turn.
It turned.
I slip out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我的镰刀对准它的关节。
lines.en: My sickles aim at its joint.

lines.zh: 它低头找东西，背对着我。
lines.en: It is looking down for something, its back to me.
I creep along the wall an inch at a time.
It steps and the ground shakes.
I pull back.
Wait for another chance.
Its legs are moving.
I move with its stride.

lines.zh: 我等它把重心移到前脚。
lines.en: I wait for it to shift its weight forward.
It has left the back of its neck open.
I slash at its leg with a sickle.
The cut opens its hide.
I retreat into the crack at once.
It turns and can't find me.
I come out and cut again.
My whole cut depends on position.
I rely on position.
If one cut fails, leave.
I circle its feet.
Once the cut lands, I pull back into the crack.
I crawl out of a crack in the stone.
Soil clings to my shell.
Antennae test the outside first.
The smells here are new.
I unfold my sickles.
Six legs find footing on the gravel.
Good damp.
I poke my antennae out of the crack.
Something bigger is moving.
I flatten down.

lines.zh: 甲壳被烤得发脆，我乱爬。
lines.en: My shell bakes brittle and I scramble.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit the stone and flip over.
Water fills my seams and I row hard.
The blast blows me into the crevice.
An arrow pins through my shell.

lines.zh: 光锁住我的腿，我动不了。
lines.en: Light locks my legs and I can't move.

lines.zh: 饿得我连镰刀都抬不起来。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift my sickles.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的腿全僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my legs go stiff.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，六条腿都在空划。
lines.en: I fall, six legs rowing at nothing.
